test_title: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 24 Jun, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: The difference between an interior angle and an exterior angle of a regular polygon is 140°. Find the number of sides of the polygon.
solution: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__ Sum of **interior angle (I)** and **exterior angle (E)** is always 180°. Given: I − E = 140° and we know I + E = 180°. Subtracting the equations: (I + E) − (I − E) = 180° − 140°. 2E = 40° ⇒ E = 20°. Number of sides (n) = 360° ÷ **Exterior Angle** = 360° ÷ 20° = 18. **∴ The correct answer is 18.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__** Given: The difference between an **interior angle** and an **exterior angle** of a **regular polygon** is 140°. Formula Used: **Interior angle (I)** + **Exterior angle (E)** = 180°; **Number of sides (n)** = 360° ÷ E. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/87e6d5dfe5a07c60de8337c1beaf3dd571bba9647219e157b7defb48e6aee726.png] Calculations: ⇒ I − E = 140° ... (Equation 1) ⇒ I + E = 180° ... (Equation 2) ⇒ Subtracting Eq. 1 from Eq. 2: ⇒ (I + E) − (I − E) = 180° − 140° ⇒ 2E = 40° ⇒ E = 20° ⇒ n = 360° ÷ 20° ⇒ n = 18 **∴ The correct answer is 18.**
